blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu lifted Farm Fresh to another comeback win, escaping PLDT, 20-25, 25-17, 23-25, 25-20, 17-15, for solo third place in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Tubu scored eight of her 30 points in the fifth set to deliver their first back-to-back wins of the series with a 4-2 record, while ending PLDT’s three-game winning streak. Down 10-13 in the decider, Tubu scored three of the Foxies’ four straight points to reach match point, 14-13.
